summary: A Notting Hill laser clinic with 490+ Google reviews appears to lose bookings to dead menu links, blank images and a booking form with no visible fields.

findings.problem: Menu dropdowns for Hydrafacial, Laser Hair Removal, Face, Body, Massage, Waxing and Skin Concerns appear to link to #.
findings.cost: Visitors cannot reach the pages that sell the treatments.
findings.fix: Working links to every treatment page.

findings.problem: Many images appear blank, an Everything You Need in One Place section appears empty, and hello world! text appears.
findings.cost: Blank areas and leftover text make a paid clinic look unfinished.
findings.fix: Real images and removal of leftover text.

findings.problem: The consultation section appears to say Pop in your details but show no fields, and Book Now appears to go to several different pages.
findings.cost: Clients who cannot find the form leave without booking.
findings.fix: One clear booking flow with a working form.

findings.problem: Only four reviews appear against a 490+ claim, and typos such as skin need's appear.
findings.cost: Thin visible proof and typos weaken the strongest claim.
findings.fix: More review quotes and proofread copy.

redesign: Real images and a clean page.
One booking flow and more reviews.
